subject: Finova — hosted API cost & peak TPS qualification
messages:
From: Aidan Cole <aidan.cole@finova.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-05-17T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up & numbers from today's demo

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for the demo this morning. Finova's PM and infra leads were impressed with the latency profile and the fallbacks you showed. A few numbers we promised to share so you and the pricing team can sketch an initial hosted cost estimate:

- Typical prompt (user -> model): ~120 tokens average
- Typical model response: ~260 tokens average
- Expected monthly active requests: ~30,000 (roughly 3–4k/day)
- Estimated steady tokens/month (prompt+response): ~11.4M tokens
- Peak TPS observed in our internal beta windows: ~20–25 TPS for ~90s during morning ingestion (user traffic spikes)
- Budget guidance from procurement: target run-rate around $10k–$15k / month for the MVP phase

Two asks: 1) Could you confirm what $/1M tokens band we'd be looking at for hosted with that profile? 2) Any immediate SLO/throughput concerns we should know about if peak TPS hits 25 TPS for a minute?

I attached a tiny traffic snapshot (CSV) that maps request counts by hour — should help with burst sizing.

Cheers,
Aidan
Senior PM, Finova
Attachments: finova-traffic-snapshot.csv

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Aidan Cole <aidan.cole@finova.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-05-17T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up & numbers from today's demo

Hi Aidan —

Appreciate the numbers and the CSV — that's really helpful. High-level notes from our side:

- Tokens: your rough 11–12M tokens/month is in a comfortable band for hosted.
- Peak TPS: 20–25 TPS spikes are common; hosted can handle this with our autoscaling and short-burst capacity, but we need to understand duration and concurrency distribution (single long-running streaming call vs many concurrent short calls).
- Cost bands: for a profile like this (avg ~380 tokens/transaction), we typically propose a tiered per-1M rate with a short-term introductory slab for MVP. I'll flag Ben on unit econ and Karthik on capacity.

Quick clarifying Qs so we can get a tight number:
1) Is the 20–25 TPS primarily concurrent short requests (few hundred ms) or long streaming responses?
2) Do you expect synchronous user-facing requests to dominate, or backend batch calls as well?
3) Any org-level compliance needs (SOC2, egress restrictions) that might push you to Dedicated/Private?

I'll attach a simple pricing worksheet that shows ballpark $/1M token numbers across a few commitment bands — fill what you can and we'll iterate. Proposed next steps: you fill the worksheet, we'll return a formal hosted quote + recommended burst policy (and estimated dollar impact).

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales (Hosted) | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Hosted-API-pricing-worksheet.xlsx

From: Aidan Cole <aidan.cole@finova.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-05-18T09:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up & numbers from today's demo

Hi Hannah —

Answers below (thanks for the worksheet):

1) Peak shape: those 20–25 TPS spikes are almost entirely concurrent short requests (each request completes ~800–1,200ms) — not streaming. Spikes happen in <2-minute bursts during morning syncs.
2) Traffic mix: ~85% synchronous user-facing, ~15% backend enrichment jobs (scheduled).
3) Compliance: SOC2 required but we're willing to start on hosted for MVP if you provide SOC2 attestation and a standard DPA.

Additional detail from infra: average tokens per transaction = ~380 (confirming your calc). Monthly request count could grow to 60k in 3–6 months if adoption is strong, so we want pricing that scales.

Procurement note on budget: they said they "expect" to be within $10k–$15k/mo but prefer a plan that keeps initial spend under $12k/mo with room to scale. From a unit-econ lens they asked for a target $/1M token band — their internal target was ~$1,000 / 1M tokens for the pilot.

Happy to hop on a quick call if that helps narrow bands.

Thanks,
Aidan
Senior PM, Finova

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Aidan Cole <aidan.cole@finova.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-05-19T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up & numbers from today's demo — hosted pricing + ops recs

Morning Aidan —

Thanks for the clarifications and the target range — helpful. Based on the 11–12M baseline and the 20–25 TPS short bursts (concurrent short requests), here's what we recommend for a hosted MVP plan that should meet your $12k/mo target while preserving reliability:

1) Pricing recommendation (hosted, monthly commit):
   - Starter slab (0–15M tokens): $950 / 1M tokens (introductory, 3-month pilot)
   - Overages: $1,300 / 1M tokens
   - If you commit 12M tokens/month for 3 months, the blended monthly spend = approx $11.4k (before tax)

2) Burst policy & operational notes:
   - We'll enable short-burst capacity for spikes up to 30 TPS for up to 120s with negligible cold-start impact.
   - We'll configure prefix caching for common system prompts to lower token spend on repeated system tokens.
   - If you anticipate sustained growth to 40–50 TPS we should discuss Dedicated or Reserved burst pool to avoid higher overage costs.

3) Compliance & paperwork:
   - SOC2 attestation is available for hosted customers; I'll loop legal for the DPA.

Next steps:
- Hannah: please send the pricing worksheet back with the preferred commitment band and whether the procurement team can sign a 3-month pilot.
- Aidan: If $950 / 1M is acceptable as a starting point, we'll prepare a short pilot quote and send DocuSign for signature.
- Ben: unit-econ check (cc'd) — please validate margin at the proposed rate.

Happy to jump on a 20-minute call this week to finalize.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Head of Product Partnerships | Redwood Inference
